definitions: A word that is absent from a text or sentence where it is expected or required.
A type of puzzle or game where participants must identify and supply a word that has been deliberately omitted from a phrase, sentence, or passage.
examples: The teacher asked us to fill in the missing word in each sentence.
The crossword puzzle had a missing word clue that was particularly tricky.
He couldn't complete the form because of a missing word in the instructions.
